programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Полевой госпиталь
programme.desc: В небольшом городке у польского приграничья, где во время полномасштабного вторжения России в Украину развернули полевой госпиталь, бок о бок трудятся украинские медики, волонтёры и квалифицированные специалисты из Израиля, Польши, США и других стран. Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. В этом месте, среди отголосков войны, продолжается жизнь: здесь появляются на свет дети, а порой — даже возникает любовь, несмотря на все испытания.

programme.title: Доктор Надежда
programme.desc: Главные герои – неотразимый доктор Родионов и роковая красотка Ольга Ольховская поженились и ждут ребенка, обаятельная Карина влюблена, неунывающие Вита Игоревна и Лев Борисович, как всегда, на посту, а карьерист Игорь Гордеев вынашивает очередной бизнес-план – в следующем сезоне хочет открыть многопрофильную клинику… Зрители снова встретятся с любимыми героями прошлого сезона – Александром Родионовым, Игорем Гордеевым, Кариной, Ритой Андреевной, неунывающими Квитко, а также познакомятся с новыми врачами – Надеждой Павловой, Андреем Смирновым, Алексеем Стрелецким и другими героями. Одной из основных линий нового сезона станет история нового врача клиники Надежды Павловой, талантливого хирурга с неустроенной личной жизнью. Героине предстоит пройти сложный путь, обрести уверенность в себе, раскрыть свой талант, заслужить прощение дочери и встретить настоящую любовь. Кто из наших любимых героев будет приглашен на новое место работы, а кто по-прежнему останется в клинике репродуктологии? Какое отделение больницы окажется в центре сюжета? Будем ли мы наблюдать, как молодые родители Оля и Саша наслаждаются семейной идиллией, или появление ребенка станет для них тяжелым испытанием? Да и вообще, можно ли будет вновь записаться на прием к доктору Родионову? Или властный Игорь Ильич пригласит других специалистов, и они выйдут на первый план? И кто станет настоящим мужчиной мечты прекрасной Надежды Павловой?

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Школа
programme.desc: Успешная бизнес-леди Катя узнает, что её дочь пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством. Как оказалось, не впервые. Чтобы быть ближе к дочери и понять, чем на самом деле занимаются дети в школе, она начинает работать учительницей экономики. Молодая мама понятия не имела, какие секреты скрываются за стенами обычной школы. Тогда же в учебное заведение приходит новый преподаватель английского - бывший адвокат и сын директора Алекс. У него есть невеста, которая живет в США, но вдруг между ним и Екатериной промелькнула искра. Впрочем, скелеты прошлого всё ещё дают о себе знать и не отпускают героев...

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Полевой госпиталь
programme.desc: В небольшом городке у польского приграничья, где во время полномасштабного вторжения России в Украину развернули полевой госпиталь, бок о бок трудятся украинские медики, волонтёры и квалифицированные специалисты из Израиля, Польши, США и других стран. Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. В этом месте, среди отголосков войны, продолжается жизнь: здесь появляются на свет дети, а порой — даже возникает любовь, несмотря на все испытания.

programme.title: Полевой госпиталь
programme.desc: В небольшом городке у польского приграничья, где во время полномасштабного вторжения России в Украину развернули полевой госпиталь, бок о бок трудятся украинские медики, волонтёры и квалифицированные специалисты из Израиля, Польши, США и других стран. Они оставили свою мирную жизнь ради того, чтобы спасать людей, пострадавших от войны. Каждый день здесь — это сочетание тяжёлых вызовов и веры в лучшее. Среди пациентов есть и военные, мужественно защищающие Украину, и мирные жители, каждый со своей нередко основанной на реальности историей. programme.title: Доктор Надежда
programme.desc: Главные герои – неотразимый доктор Родионов и роковая красотка Ольга Ольховская поженились и ждут ребенка, обаятельная Карина влюблена, неунывающие Вита Игоревна и Лев Борисович, как всегда, на посту, а карьерист Игорь Гордеев вынашивает очередной бизнес-план – в следующем сезоне хочет открыть многопрофильную клинику… Зрители снова встретятся с любимыми героями прошлого сезона – Александром Родионовым, Игорем Гордеевым, Кариной, Ритой Андреевной, неунывающими Квитко, а также познакомятся с новыми врачами – Надеждой Павловой, Андреем Смирновым, Алексеем Стрелецким и другими героями. Одной из основных линий нового сезона станет история нового врача клиники Надежды Павловой, талантливого хирурга с неустроенной личной жизнью. Героине предстоит пройти сложный путь, обрести уверенность в себе, раскрыть свой талант, заслужить прощение дочери и встретить настоящую любовь. Кто из наших любимых героев будет приглашен на новое место работы, а кто по-прежнему останется в клинике репродуктологии? Какое отделение больницы окажется в центре сюжета? Будем ли мы наблюдать, как молодые родители Оля и Саша наслаждаются семейной идиллией, или появление ребенка станет для них тяжелым испытанием? Да и вообще, можно ли будет вновь записаться на прием к доктору Родионову? Или властный Игорь Ильич пригласит других специалистов, и они выйдут на первый план? И кто станет настоящим мужчиной мечты прекрасной Надежды Павловой?

programme.title: Крепостная
programme.desc: Юная сирота Катерина Вербицкая — очень красивая, умная и образованная девушка. Благодаря ее крестной матери Катю воспитали как барышню благородных кровей. Она знает иностранные языки, играет на фортепиано, рисует и прекрасно понимает, что все это никак не облегчит судьбу рожденной в неволе. Катерина принадлежит самым богатым помещикам в Нежине — Червинским. Девушка существует между двумя мирами — миром крепостных и дворян. И ни в одном из них для нее нет места. Жизнь приготовила Катерине немало сюрпризов. В борьбе за свое счастье ей придется пережить смерти близких, спастись от преследований маньяка, выбраться из мира киевских борделей. И главное — победить свою хозяйку, жестокую помещицу, которая хочет убить ее. Крепостная пройдет сквозь ад и встретится с ужасными испытаниями судьбы. Что же ее ждет в конце жесткой борьбы за право быть свободной и любимой?

programme.title: Страх в твоем доме
programme.desc: Боль и страдания, которые причиняют самые близкие люди, невыносимы. Дом из крепости становится тюрьмой. И в поисках выхода людям приходится идти на самые невероятные поступки. Ни один сценарист не сможет придумать такие сюжетные ходы, которые порой закручивает сама жизнь. В социальной докудраме "Страх в твоем доме" - только реальные истории, случившиеся с реальными людьми. Мы реконструируем события, основываясь на откровенных рассказах их участников, а наши эксперты - юристы и психологи - комментируют их и помогают найти выход из сложных, порой тупиковых ситуаций.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Mystery movie. American mystery, produced in 2017. Retired homicide detective Ray Archer and his partner, ex FBI agent Will Ruiney, are assigned to track down a vicious serial killer, who is playing a twisted version of the children's game 'Hangman'.

programme.title: American Traitor
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Eccentric, brilliant lawyer James Laughlin (Al Pacino) boldly accepts the case to defend American entertainer Mildred Gillars (Meadow Williams) from ten counts of treason charged by the US government regardless of the inevitable backlash from his country. During WWII, Mildred became a powerful weapon in the hands of the Nazis and was forced to sing defeatist war propaganda to US soldiers based in Europe. Terrorized and raped by Joseph Goebbels, Hitler's right-hand man, Mildred broadcasts hate-filled messages in order to survive the dark and dangerous world of the Third Reich. Despite attempting to murder Goebbels, Mildred is eventually captured by American authorities and sent to trial where, against all odds, Laughlin struggles to redeem her reputation and maintain his own.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: Buster and Babs talk about the "call of the wild" and animal instincts. "Migrant Mallard": Plucky attempts to migrate with a flock of ducks and makes several attempts to modernize them in the process. At the end, the ducks are portrayed flying south while listening to Walkman's. "It's a Jungle Out There": Concord Condor escapes the zoo in search of "wide open spaces." After being pursued by Arnold the Pitbull and other creatures, he returns to the zoo. "Kitty Cat-Astrophe": Furrball fantasizes that he is living in prehistoric times and ends up destroying Hamton's kitchen.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond, a money launderer struggling with memory loss sustained in a car crash, goes on the run, evading the police while carrying heaps of stolen cash he knows nothing about. Moe and his partner in crime Bobby "Skunk" Cohen had been given a job by Bobby's uncle Perico, wherein he gave them a sum of $20 million to launder. However, the two are ambushed while doing a side job by corrupt police officers. The two manage to escape the cops, but soon after end up in a car accident.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: The first episode of a medical crime thriller series following a team of investigators as they uncover corruption and negligence. Dr Lucinda Edwards is a smart and experienced A and E doctor in the midst of a nightmare shift - she has a gunshot victim and an opioid overdose patient who both need a bed in resus, but there's only room for one of them. When one of the patients dies, Lucinda realises that her troubles have only just begun as she faces a probe by the Medical Investigation Unit.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night.

programme.title: Summer Dreams
programme.desc: Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: Action movie. American action, produced in 2017. FBI agent Gretchen Blair receives a strange offer from a fellow passenger regarding an impending hijacking. She soon finds herself trapped in a mid-air heist, fighting to protect everyone on board.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Cookies Fortune
programme.desc: Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: When Do We Eat?
programme.desc: A family's Passover gets screwy after the patriarch unknowingly ingests a hit of Ecstasy.

programme.title: Existenz
programme.desc: In the near-future, biotechnological virtual reality game consoles known as "game pods" have replaced electronic ones. The pods present "UmbyCords" that attach to "bio-ports", connectors surgically inserted into players' spines. Two game companies, Antenna Research and Cortical Systematics, compete against each other. In addition, the Realists fight both companies to prevent the "deforming" of reality.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Baba
programme.desc: An weird but witty old woman is forced to deal with an ambiguous future after her country, family and the entire system of values are ruined. She is trying to solve her existential problems catching d trying to sell a rewarded war criminal as he was a rabbit in a wood. The only thing she did not know if he is really him.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Music critic Bob is out of a job, addicted to Zoloft, and trying to wrangle the menagerie of animals that his wife Linda has accumulated. Will adopting a baby cure their existential angst? Or should they just rescue another duck?

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Departure
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: Conspiracy
programme.desc: In the not so distant future, a team of white collar criminals are enlisted by the Federal government to thwart a cyber-attack that threatens to bankrupt the United States of America.

programme.title: Night Vision
programme.desc: A psycho serial killer who videotapes each of his bloody conquests is on the loose, and it's up to alcoholic motorcycle cop Dak and his new tough-as-nails partner, Kristen, to bring him to justice. But as the body count increases, so does the danger.

programme.title: Shaka Zulu: The Citadel
programme.desc: Prentice Mungo (David Hasselhoff) is a slave-trader who discovers that his ship is carrying a stowaway, Katherine (Karen Allen). Katherine is seeking passage to Africa to see her father, a British officer stationed there. But when they arrive, Mungo discovers Shaka, king of the Zulu tribe, among the slaves he is going to be transporting. Using his cleverness and leadership abilities, Zulu incites the slaves to revolt, and takes Katherine captive as he flees into the African countryside.

programme.title: Pretīgais astotnieks
programme.desc: ASV pēc Pilsoņu kara. Leģendārais mednieks par atlīdzību Džons Ruts konvojē noziedznieci Deiziju uz Redroku, lai tur viņai spriestu tiesu par slepkavību. Pēc tam, kad, satiekot vēl dažus ceļiniekus, viņus pārsteidz sniega vētra, kompānijai nākas meklēt patvērumu meža būdā, kur viņus jau sagaida visai raiba sabiedrība vēl četru cilvēku sastāvā. Pamazām rodas aizdomas, ka šī tikšanās nav bijusi nejauša un katram no astotnieka ir savi, pavisam nopietni iemesli šeit atrasties.

programme.title: Dzīvoklis augšstāvā
programme.desc: Pieci precēti puiši slepenībā uztur augšstāva loftu, kur iespējams nodarboties ar afērām. Fantāzija kļūst par murgu, kad viņi uziet mirušas sievietes ķermeni. Turklāt, viens no grupas šajā notikumā ir iesaistīts.

programme.desc: Gados vecs bijušais karavīrs pēc drauga slepkavības meklē taisnīgumu.

programme.title: Algotnis
programme.desc: 23 gadīgais Mičs zaudējis savu līgavu teroristu uzbrukumā ir apsēsts ar atriebību. Viņš uzsāk apmācības specvienības rotā, lai atrastu un nogalinātu tos, kuri ir atbildīgi par viņas līgavas slepkavību. Par viņa instruktoru tiek nozīmēts Aukstā kara veterāns, ar kuru kopā viņi izmeklēs it kā savstarpēji nesaistītus teroristu uzbrukumus. Izmeklēšana viņus aizvedīs uz pēdām izbijušam CIP aģentam, kurš ir apmāts ar kara uzsākšanu Tuvajos austrumos.

programme.title: Grūtie laiki viesnīcā El Royale
programme.desc: 1969. gads. Viesnīcā "El Royale" ir apmetusies ļoti raiba kompānija - nīgrs mācītājs, dziedātāja, enerģisks putekļu sūcēju pārdevējs un arī aizdomīga meiča no Dienvidiem. Katram no viņiem ir savi noslēpumi un katram būs iespēja izpirkt savus pagātnes grēkus.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Šķirts no savas dzimtās zemes un mīļotās sievietes, Spartacus ir notiesāts brutālai arēnas pasaulei, kur asinis un nāve ir primāra izklaide. Taču ne visas kaujas noris arēnā. Nodevība, korupcija un sensuālu baudu vilinājums patstāvīgi ieskaus varoni. Lai izdzīvotu, viņam ir jākļūst vairāk par vīrieti. Vairāk par parastu gladiatoru. Viņam ir jākļūst par leģendu.

programme.title: Džekija Brauna
programme.desc: Džekija Brauna strādā par stjuarti avikompānīja un piepelnās, pārvadājot noziedzniekiem naudu no Meksikas uz ASV. Viņu pieķer policija, līdz ar to viņa tiek piespiesta darboties tās labā. Džekija saprot, ka staigā pa plānu ledu, un ja tiks pieķerta, nebūs vairs dzīvotāja. Tā nu viņa uzsāk savu spēli...

programme.title: Adrenalīns
programme.desc: Pieredzējušā killera Čeva Čeliosa asinīs ir ielaista inde, kas viņu nogalinās, ja Čeva pulsa biežums nokritīs zemāk par noteikto atzīmi. Tagad viņa vienīgā izeja ir, nepazeminot adrenalīna līmeni asinīs, pacensties atriebties saviem pāridarītājiem pirms inde sāk iedarboties...

programme.title: Divas Megijas
programme.desc: Lieliski savērpta melnā komēdija, kas aizved skatītājus negaidītā ceļojumā uz šķietami parastu pilsētiņu. Putekļainajā tuksneša pilsētelē, kur nekad nekas nenotiek, policijas priekšniekam pēkšņi jāatrisina divas slepkavības pēc kārtas, kurās nogalinātas sievietes ar vienādu vārdu. Kriminālkomēdijas režisors ir Džons Sleterijs (seriāls "Mad Men"), galvenjās lomās Niks Mohameds (seriāls "Ted Lasso"), Džons Hems (seriāls "Mad Men", "Top Gun: Maveriks") un Tīna Feja ("Māsas", seriāls "30 Rock").

programme.title: Substance
programme.desc: Holivudas fitnesa zvaigznei Elizabetei ir viss, ko sieviete var vēlēties - skaistums, slava un ietekme. Taču pienāk laiks, kad vecuma pazīmes draud viņai to visu atņemt. Tādēļ brīdī, kad viņa uzzina par jauno produktu "Substance", kurš sola jaunāku un perfektāku sevi, viņa nevilcinās to izmēģināt.

programme.title: Tu neesi tu
programme.desc: Algotais slepkava ar iesauku "Nāves eņģelis" Maikls Salivans uzticīgi kalpo savam bosam Džonam Rūnijam, pateicoties kuram reiz uz ielas atrastais bārenis Maiks ir ieguvis "augstāko izglītību" gangsteru profesijā. Aukstasinīgais un nežēlīgais Rūnijs - Čikāgas īru mafijas krusttēvs - , kura organizācija asi konkurē ar itāļiem, veldzējumu savai sirdij gūst vienīgi Maikla sabiedrībā un rotaļājoties ar Maikla abiem dēliem Maiklu junioru un Pīteru. Abu pusaudžu acīs pilsētas gangsteru vadonis ir ne vairāk kā jauks vectēvs - interesantu un audzinošu stāstu zinātājs un zēnu labākais draugs viņu kopējās spēlēs.

programme.title: Tālu no trokšņainā pūļa
programme.desc: Viktorijas laikmeta Anglijā neatkarīgā un stūrgalvīgā Batšeba Everdena ir lepna un skaista sieviete, kura piesaista triju dažādiem sabiedrības slāņiem piederošu vīriešu uzmanību. Pēc Batšebas tikšanās ar aitu fermas īpašnieku Gabriēlu Ouku pārgalvīgo seržantu Frensisu Troju un turīgo vecpuisi Viljamu Boldvudu, viņu dzīves vairs nekad nebūs tādas, kā iepriekš.

programme.title: Suņu sala

programme.title: Tu neesi tu

programme.title: Stiprāks
programme.desc: Vienkāršais strādnieku puisis Džefs 2013. gada Bostonas maratona sprādziena laikā tiek smagi ievainots. Slimnīcā viņam tiek amputētas abas kājas, bet nelaimes brīdī Džefs ir izšķīries ar draudzeni Erīnu. Pēc traģiskā notikuma Erīna viņam ir blakus katru dienu, un tieši tas kļūst par pamatu Džefa vēlmei dzīvot un cīņai ar alkohola atkarību. Drāmas "Stiprāks" scenārijs ir balstīts uz patiesiem notikumiem. Džefa stāsts aizkustināja miljoniem cilvēku visā pasaulē, savukārt žurnālisti viņu padarīja teju par rokzvaigzni. Tā kā jaunā vīrieša ikdiena no traģēdijas brīža tika regulāri atspoguļota visdažādākajos medijos, viņš kļuva par iedvesmas avotu tiem cilvēkiem, kuri meklēja spēku, kā pārvarēt gan fiziskas, gan emocionālas sāpes. Šī filma tiek uzskatīta par vienu no galvenās lomas atveidotāja Džeika Džilenhola labākajiem darbiem. Aktieris vēsta, ka vairākkārt ticies ar īsto Džefu Baumani, un abi ļoti satuvinājušies.

programme.title: Džūlija(s)
programme.desc: Stāsts par 80 gadus vecu Jūliju, kura pārdomā lēmumus un apstākļus savā dzīvē, kas varēja viņu novest pa dažādiem ceļiem.

programme.title: Solo
programme.desc: Sekosim Saimonam, kuram jātiek galā ar divām neiespējamām vilšanām: kaislīgu, bet destruktīvu simpātiju pret Oliveru un attālām un aukstām attiecībām ar savu māti Klēru, kura tikko atgriezusies pie viņa pēc 15 gadu prombūtnes.

programme.title: La Pitchoune: Cooking In France
programme.desc: After much uncertainty, the Courageous Cooking school at Julia Child's cottage in France is back with a new group of students. Makenna Held and her husband, Chris, run the recipe-free school with executive chef Kendall Lane and her husband, Ross.

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: Eric Adjepong hosts as experienced bakers and successful competitors Keya Wingfield, Melissa Yanc and Karina Rivera join forces to take down Chef Alex Guarnaschelli in a pastry battle. As the cuisines get even more difficult, Alex must use her expertise in gameplay to outthink and outcook her opponents. Stephanie Boswell and Sherry Yard judge the two rounds of competition, where the chefs have a chance to win up to $15,000, but only if they can defeat Chef Alex!

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: It's six against one! Never before seen in the Alex vs America arena, host Eric Adjepong invites three restaurant teams, consisting of an executive chef and sous chef, to take on Iron Chef Alex Guarnaschelli. With only herself to rely on, Alex will have to outcook acclaimed teams of chefs who have years of experience cooking together. In two rounds, where anyone can be sent home, will she be able to keep up? The expert team of restaurateurs and brothers Michael and Bryan Voltaggio serve as judges for these exciting battles.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Crunchy or soft, minimalist or filled to the max, it's taco time! The chefs are tasked with making tacos that are worth ten thousand bucks. A beverage is in the first basket, as well as a seafood surprise. Meaty tacos are in the works for the entree round, but can the competitors find a place on their plates for a squirmy shocker? Then, spicy dessert tacos sound delicious in the final round, however, time management issues become a problem after both chefs decide to make tortillas from scratch.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Ooh la la! When the Chopped baskets contain aphrodisiacs, the judges expect the competitors to come through with some sexy dishes. A favorite seductive seafood meets a pun-tastic item in the appetizer basket. In the entree basket, a heart-shaped comfort food and a sweet fruit make for a rare pair. The two competitors who rendezvous in the final round hustle to make sexy desserts with a quirky pie and a spicy root.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: A devoted father sinks his retirement savings into the neighborhood bar that shaped his life. But as his loyal customer base literally dies off, he must learn to let go of the past. Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez help him confront his fear of change and allow his daughter to step up to the plate.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: A Mexican restaurant suffocates under high-interest debt, delivery apps draining profits, and a matriarch clinging to outworn ideas. Her son, a classically trained chef, asks Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez for help to save his mother's life's work.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond cuts down on the cleanup with four one-pot recipes. The non-stick skillet is perfect for Breakfast Hash with fried eggs and a multi-pasta pot is all you need for Loaded Veggie Pasta. A Dutch oven is the ideal choice for making Sweet Heat Chicken Thighs -- an incredibly easy all-in-one super supper. Finally, an old favorite gets a new role for a Shortcut Cast Iron Pizza that's off-the-scale delicious.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel
programme.desc: Host Tituss Burgess asks the six remaining chefs to team up and create a steak feast for VIP guest Poppy O'Toole. While one team doesn't have any steak, the other lacks Poppy's favorite ingredient: potatoes. With limited ingredients on hand, the chefs must lean on their creativity and hope to inherit the best produce, protein and pantry items from a dearly departed colleague. As the competition heats up, the chefs carefully decide how to handle both their ingredients and their competition. One wrong move is all it takes to find yourself in Room 13.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship
programme.desc: Seven courageous bakers are tasked with creating terrifying desserts in this spooky baking competition. Hosted by ventriloquist Jeff Dunham and his sidekick Walter, the competition invites talented bakers to showcase their talents in Halloween-themed challenges. They will have to conjure all of their baking abilities if they are to become the champion, and the winner of the series takes home a frightening $25,000. With a number of prominent judges overseeing their work, there is no room for error, and contestants are eliminated each week until only one remains.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Simple Pleasures
programme.desc: Rachel Khoo's Simple Pleasure is a brand-new Food Network series that follows chef, writer and broadcaster Rachel Khoo as she makes a range of mouth-watering dishes that she loves to cook at home. Bringing all her usual flair and style, Rachel confidently and creatively transforms seemingly ordinary, easy-to-find ingredients into extraordinary meals and draws out the joy that can be found in simple, tasty home cooking.

programme.title: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
programme.desc: Magnolia Table: At the Farm, Joanna welcomes viewers into her home to share cherished family recipes and seasonal favorites – from quick snacks to Sunday treats. Along the way, she offers helpful cooking tips, celebrates the beauty of fresh ingredients, and invites audiences to enjoy the simple pleasures of time spent in some of her favorite spaces around the farm.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bobby's Triple Threat
programme.desc: Miami chef Adrianne Calvo won SOBE Food and Wine Festival's Triple Threat competition, but can she take down Bobby Flay's Titans on their home turf to win $25,000? OG restaurateur Rick Bayless amps up the pressure with his judging.

programme.title: Bobby Flay's the Line
programme.desc: Cooking - Ep. 1. A resident team of all-star line cooks face off against visiting teams of kitchen brigades in a battle to determine who can serve the best food.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

Hosted by ventriloquist Jeff Dunham and his sidekick Walter, the competition invites talented bakers to showcase their talents in Halloween-themed challenges. They will have to conjure all of their baking abilities if they are to become the champion, and the winner of the series takes home a frightening $25,000. With a number of prominent judges overseeing their work, there is no room for error, and contestants are eliminated each week until only one remains.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel
programme.desc: Host Tituss Burgess asks the remaining five chefs to create a stunning noodle dish for VIP guest and Iron Chef Michael Symon, using an ingredient bequeathed to them by a recently eliminated chef along with their own dwindling ingredients. The winning chef will inherit the rest of the bequeathed trunk, but the bottom two competitors will face off in a sudden-death cooking round highlighting the humble pickled egg. The losing chef will be forced into the mysterious Room 13, never to be seen again.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Form of Fire
programme.desc: The film tells about the first days after the liberation of the city from the invaders, focusing on the work of rescuers, who in conditions of chaos and danger became the main hope for local residents. In addition to the hard daily work of clearing the roads from the remains of destroyed enemy equipment, the heroes of the film demonstrate incredible selflessness, rushing into the very hell — an apartment building engulfed in flames after another shelling — to save people from the fiery trap. This documentary story becomes a powerful testimony to humanity and professional heroism, which are most clearly manifested even in the most difficult times, when life is on the verge of death.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: The documentary film "Sisters" tells the story of humanity, compassion, and the power of support that help Ukrainians overcome the pain of loss during war. The film shows the stories of women who, having experienced their own tragedy, turned their pain into a good deed. Twin sisters from Dnipro launched a volunteer project "Search with Love and Hope" to care for the graves of Ukrainian soldiers whose families cannot come to the burial sites. The film is not only a story of loss, but also of deep solidarity and gratitude. It reminds us that even in the most difficult times, Ukrainians stick together, support each other, and honor those who gave their lives for freedom.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Photographs
programme.desc: What can two photographs reveal about truth, memory, and history? This documentary follows the story behind two striking images, exploring their origins, the moments they captured, and the impact they had on society. As layers of context unfold, the film questions how images can shape narratives, influence emotions, and even alter reality. Through interviews, archival material, and thoughtful analysis, it invites viewers to look beyond the frame and reconsider the power of visual storytelling.

programme.title: Stay Calm. The Air Defence System
programme.desc: The documentary project is dedicated to defenders Ukrainian sky. programme.title: Kherson: A People Safari
programme.desc: This is a 72-minute documentary about one of the most invincible cities in Ukraine during the Great War. This is the story of Kherson, from the first days of the full-scale Russian invasion, through the difficult years of occupation, to the long-awaited liberation and constant Russian shelling. But it is not only about the war - it is also about how life goes on, even when everything around it seems to be crumbling.

programme.title: Sensitive Content
programme.desc: Heroes of the project " Contents "sensitive nature" - people who looking at war through the lens . Stas Kozlyuk, Ephraim Lukatsky , Olga Kovaleva and their colleagues in the shop chose his/her own camera as a tool , not a weapon . This a story about the fine line between professional debt and personal trauma, about attempts save humanity , documenting the disaster. Their work is not just fixing destruction , it is a living memory and testimony truth that is impossible ignore.

programme.title: Lemāna-'66: Lielais izaicinājums
programme.desc: Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".

programme.title: Baseina vīrs
programme.desc: Derens Barenmans ir īsts losandželosietis un nelabojams optimists. Vadot dienas, pieskatīdams Taiti Tiki dzīvokļu kvartāla baseinu, viņš cenšas padarīt savu pilsētu par labāku vietu dzīvošanai.

programme.title: Brutālists
programme.desc: Bēgdams no pēckara Eiropas, arhitekts Lāslo Tots ierodas Amerikā, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi, atrastu darbu un gaidītu sievu Eržēbeti, kura cenšas izkļūt no Austrumeiropas. Svešajā un jaunajā valstī Lāslo apmetas Filadelfijā, kur bagātais un ietekmīgais rūpnieks Harisons Lī Van Būrens pamana viņa talantu. Lāslo ir jāatrod savs ceļš jaunajā pasaulē, kurā valda citi noteikumi. Amerikāņu sapnis šķiet iluzors, panākumi un slava maksā lielu cenu…

programme.title: Ledus laikmets 3: Dinozauru ēra
programme.desc: Filmu "Ledus laikmets" un "Ledus Laikmets 2" varoņi ir atgriezušies - gatavi jauniem piedzīvojumiem. Skrets joprojām nododas nenotveramās zīles medībām. Menijs un Elija gaida mazuļa piedzimšanu, sliņķis Sids mēģina iztēloties ģimenes dzīvi, rūpējoties par nočieptām dinozaura olām, bet zobenzobu tīģeris Djego apsver, vai viņš nav kļuvis pārāk mīkstčaulīgs, tik daudz laika pavadot draugu kompānijā. Dodoties glābt nelaimē nokļuvušo Sidu, draugi nokļūst neparastā pazemes pasaulē, kur aci pret aci sastopas ar dinozauriem un ir spiesti cīnīties gan ar zvēriem, gan augiem.

programme.title: Mīluļi apvienojas
programme.desc: Klusā, bet ļoti mūsdienīgā pilsētā Robo notiek kas neredzēts un nedzirdēts. Mērs Frenks ir zaudējis prātu. Viņa plāns neiekļaujas nekādos rāmjos. Tikai paklausieties! Viņam apnikuši cilvēki un dzīvnieki, tāpēc viņš savā prātā perina plānu - visus iedzīvotājus un mājdzīvniekus izdzīt no pilsētas un viņu mājas atdot robotiem! Kad suns bez pajumtes Rodžers uzzina šo jaunumu, viņam visas spalvas saceļas stāvus. Šis Robins Huds daudz laika pavadījis uz ielas, nočiepis dažu labu gardas desas luņķi, lai to atdotu vājākiem dzīvniekiem, un nu jūt, ka mēra plāns pie laba gala nenovedīs. No pilsētas pazudīs dzīvība! Atgriezies no jaukas pastaigas kopā ar daiļo Siāmas kaķenīti Bellu, Rodžers šausmās sastingst. Roboti sagrāvuši viņa vienīgo būdiņu! Mukdams ko nagi nes, Rodžers piepeši satiek labsirdīgo robotu Bobu, kuram mēra nodoms šķiet briesmīgs. Ir jārīkojas! Jāglābjas pašiem un jāglābj citi. Ja nekas netiks darīts, greznā mājdzīvnieku viesnīca būs briesmās. Nekā ļauna nenojauzdami, tajā mitinās daudzi četrkājainie.

programme.title: Varenais Ričards
programme.desc: Ričards ir jauns zvirbulēns, kuru savā lokā pieņēmusi stārķu ģimene. Viņš pavada ziemu Āfrikas ziemeļos, taču ir pienācis laiks atgriezties mājās. Ričards vēlas vadīt gājputnu kāsi, bet šim uzdevumam tiek izraudzīts viņa pusbrālis Makss. Jaunais putnēns jūtas aizvainots, taču drīz sākas vētrains piedzīvojums. Tirāniskais pāvs Zamano sagūsta Ričarda draugu. Zamano atsakās viņu laist brīvībā, kamēr Ričards neatrisinās mīklu un neatradīs Zamano dārgakmeni.

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Animācijas filmas "Ledus laikmets" veidotāji sagatavojuši jaunu piedzīvojumu komēdiju visai ģimenei. Blū ir pieradināts papagailis, kas tā arī nav iemācījies lidot. Viņš visu mūžu baudījis ērtības Minesotas štata mazpilsētā, kur dzīvo kopā ar savu saimnieci Lindu. Blū un Linda ir pārliecināti, ka viņš ir pēdējais savas sugas pārstāvis, taču, kad izrādās, ka Riodežaneiro dzīvo arī krāšņā Džuela, abi dodas uz turieni, lai viņu uzmeklētu. Jau drīz vien pēc ierašanās Blū un Džuelu nolaupa eksotisko dzīvnieku tirgotāji. Taču Džuela ir radusi pie dzīves pilsētas ielās, un ar vairāku runājošu putnu palīdzību viņiem izdodas tikt brīvībā. Draugu un Džuelas iedrošināts, Blū beidzot iemācīsies lidot, lai varētu atgriezties pie savas labākās draudzenes Lindas.

programme.title: Robotu sapņi
programme.desc: Suņa un robota piedzīvojumi un neveiksmes Ņujorkā 80.-ajos gados.

programme.title: Snīkeri
programme.desc: "Snīkeri" seko Taja piedzīvojumiem, kas ir maldu pārņemts dizainera snīkers, kurš nepazīst dzīvi ārpus savas ērtās kurpju kastes ar samta apdari. Kad šaubīgs kolekcionārs nozog viņa māsu, Tajam jādodas uz Ņujorku, lai viņu atrastu un izglābtu. Šajā piedzīvojumā Tajs sastop dažāda dzīves gājuma nodilušu apavu draugu kompāniju, kas viņam palīdz rast drosmi izkāpt no savas kurpju kastes un atrast savu "dvēseles radinieci".

programme.title: Tafiti: Pāri tuksnesim
programme.desc: Tafiti, jauns surikāts, sākumā noraida draudzību ar Bristlsu, krūmu cūku. Kad viņa vectēvam iekož čūska, Tafiti dodas ceļā, lai atrastu ziedu, kas varētu vectētiņu izārstēt. Bristlss vēlas pierādīt, ka piedzīvojumi vienmēr ir labāki kopā ar draugiem.

programme.title: Princese Mononoke
programme.desc: Nāvējošs lāsts padzen jauno cīnītāju Ašitaku no mājām. Ašitaka dodas uz rietumiem un tiek ierauts konfliktā starp seniem meža gariem, dzelzs pilsētu un starp vilkiem augušu meiteni.

programme.title: Kaut tu būtu šeit
programme.desc: Jauna dāma, meklējot dzīvei uguntiņu, pavada romantisku nakti kopā ar kādu jaunekli. Atklādama, ka vīrietis ir nedziedināmi slims, sieviete apņemas palīdzēt viņam pilnvērtīgi nodzīvot pēdējās šeit atvēlētās dienas.

programme.title: Es, robots
programme.desc: 2035. gads. Tuvajā nākotnē daudz kas ir mainījies. Roboti, līdzīgi kā citi zinātnes un tehnikas brīnumi, ir kļuvuši par cilvēku ikdienas neatņemamu sastāvdaļu. Viņiem tiek uzticētas mājas, bērni un pat dzīvības. Roboti ir veiklāki un stiprāki par cilvēkiem, turklāt ir ieprogrammēti tā, lai nevarētu nodarīt pāri nevienam cilvēkam. Taču nesen ir notikusi slepkavība, par kuru aizdomās tiek turēts mājas robots. Detektīvs Džons Spuners tic - ja viens robots pārkāpis likumu, to spēs arī citi. Izmeklētājs meklē taisnību, lai atvērtu cilvēkiem acis un izvairītos no kara ar robotiem. Taču varbūt ir jau par vēlu?

programme.title: Ar ieročiem rokās
programme.desc: Mailzs, pieaudzis vīrietis, kura bērnības sapņi neīstenojās, vada savas dienas, izniekojot laiku pie datora un kaitinot tīmekļa troļļus ar dzēlīgiem komentāriem. Kādu dienu viņš uzzina par tīmekļa sensāciju "Skizm", kas iesaista cilvēkus spēlē uz dzīvību un nāvi. Mailzs sāk kaitināt spēles skatītājus un piesaista vietnes administratoru uzmanību. Viņi ielaužas Mailza mājā, nolaupa vīrieti un piespiež iesaistīties iznīcinošajā spēlē. Mailzam ir uzdevums – nogalināt Niksu, vienu no nežēlīgākajām "Skizm" spēlētājām. Sākas postoša, spraiga un stilīga spēle – kurš izdzīvos?

programme.title: Lady Bird: Laiks lidot
programme.desc: Aktrises Grētas Gervigas spožā debija režijā - dramēdija "Lady Bird" - šķetina dumpinieciskās tīnes Kristīnes un viņas mammas attiecības, atklājot gan humora, gan patosa pilnos emocionālos kāpumus, kritumus un izvirdumus. Kristīne, kura sev piešķīrusi pseidonīmu "Lady Bird", ar jaunietei raksturīgo maksimālismu cīnās pretī mammas gādībai, 'senču' dzīves uzskatiem un 'rāmjiem', cenšoties lauzt pati savu ceļu dzīvē – tālāk prom no provinciālās, ekonomisko svārstību skartās pilsētas Kalifornijā, prom uz Ņujorku. Jo tieši tur, viņasprāt, gaida īstā dzīve.

programme.title: Grenlande. Migrācija
programme.desc: Izdzīvojusi Grenlandes bunkurā, Garitiju ģimene dodas pāri sagrautai Eiropai, lai atrastu jaunas mājas.

programme.title: Ferdinands
programme.desc: Ferdinands ir pats labsirdīgākais bullis visā Spānijā. Neskatoties uz iespaidīgajiem izmēriem un milzu spēku, viņš jau kopš bērnības neizrādīja sevišķu interesi par badīšanos ar saviem sugas brāļiem. Nejaušības dēļ Ferdinands nokļūst to vidū, kuri tiek izvēlēti, lai piedalītos buļļu cīņās Madridē. Tagad Ferdinandam nāksies aizstāvēt savus miermīlīgos dzīves uzskatus un atgādināt pārējiem, ka grūtību priekšā galvenais ir palikt, kāds tu esi. Jo tikai tā tu spēsi izmainīt pasauli sev apkārt.

programme.title: Ēnu spēle
programme.desc: Treviss Bloks ir FIB problēmu risinātājs. Kad slepenie aģenti nonāk nepatikšanās, Treviss tiek izsaukts, lai viņus izpestītu. Par katru cenu. Taču, kad viens no slepenajiem aģentiem apšauba savas priekšniecības patiesos mērķus, Treviss nonāk asiņainas sazvērestības epicentrā.

programme.title: Flīks
programme.desc: Zaudējis spēju staigāt, Tomass apvienojas ar maģisku radījumu, lai stātos pretī ēnu briesmonim un atveseļotos.

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Rio
programme.desc: Blū, Pērle un viņu trīs bērni dzīvo mājas idillē burvīgajā Riodežaneiro pilsētā. Kad Pērle nolemj, ka bērniem jāmācās dzīvot īstu putnu dzīvi, viņa uzstāj, ka ģimenei jādodas uz Amazoni. Blū, cenšoties sadraudzēties ar jaunajiem kaimiņiem, baidās zaudēt Pērli un bērnus, kuri ļaujas savvaļas dzīves aicinājumam.

programme.title: Slepkavība Austrumu ekspresī
programme.desc: Ceļojums vienā no krāšņākajiem Eiropas vilcieniem pārvēršas vienā no sarežģītākajām un visaizraujošākajām mīklām kriminālistikas vēsturē. Savā kupejā miris tiek atrasts noslēpumainais amerikāņu miljonārs Rečets un nav šaubu, ka slepkava ir viens no pasažieriem. Kamēr puteņa dēļ vilciens ir apstājies un nošķirts no ārējās pasaules, detektīvam Eriklam Puaro ir jānoskaidro slepkava, pirms tas uzbruks atkal.

programme.title: Roboti
programme.desc: Arī pasaulē, kurā mīt tikai mehāniskas būtnes, ir vajadzīgi izgudrotāji. Rodnijs ir vienkāršs robotpuika, trauku mazgājamās mašīnas dēls, taču viņam ir liels sapnis - sastapt pašu varenāko robotu pasaules personu lielo Veldu. Rodnijs lielpilsētā ierodas tieši lielo pārmaiņu brīdī, kad daudzu robotu dzīve nonāk briesmās. Kopā ar saviem draugiem - izklaidīgo Fenderu un apzinīgo Paiperi - Rodnijs spēj paveikt vairāk, nekā pats iedomājies.

programme.title: Viņš ir viņa
programme.desc: Ļoti brīva Šekspīra lugas "Divpadsmitā nakts" ekranizācija. Pārvācoties uz citu skolu, Viola maina arī savu izskatu un uzdodas par savu dvīņubrāli Sebastjanu, kurš pats pārcēlies uz Londonu. Taču meitene nemaz nenojauš, ka viņu gaida pārsteigums, – viņa iemīlēsies savā istabas biedrā un skolas karstākajā puisī Djūkā, kura sirds savukārt pieder skaistulei Olīvijai. Taču šī meitene ir pamanījusi Sebastjanu – emocionālo puisi, kādi viņai vienmēr patikuši. Un, kaut arī šķiet, ka nekas nevar būt vēl trakāk, ierodas īstais Sebastjans, kurš nemaz nenojauš, ka viņu aizvieto paša dvīņu māsa!

programme.title: Pasaules gala mednieki
programme.desc: Pēc tam kad milzīga saules uzliesmojuma dēļ tiek iznīcināta Zemes austrumu puslode, drosmīgs algots dārgumu mednieks dodas uz Eiropu, lai atrastu iekāroto "Monu Lizu", taču drīz saprot, ka pasaulei šobrīd vajag varoni vairāk nekā gleznu.

programme.title: Operācija Black Bag
programme.desc: Izlūkdienesta aģente Katrīna Vudhausa tiek turēta aizdomās par valsts nodevību. Viņas vīrs, leģendārais slepenais aģents Džordžs Vudhauss, saskaras ar nepiespējamu pārbaudījumu – būt uzticīgam savai laulībai vai valstij.

programme.title: Pašpaļāvība
programme.desc: Tomijam tiek piedāvāts viens miljons dolāru, lai piedalītos izdzīvošanās spēlē, kurā īsti mednieki viņu mēģinās nogalināt. Viņš piekrīt, jo ir pārliecināts, ka atradis "robu" noteikumos - uzbrukt viņam drīkst tikai tad, kad viņš ir vienatnē. Vienīgā problēma, neviens no viņa draugiem un ģimenes netic, ka spēle ir īsta.

programme.title: Cietais rieksts
programme.desc: Džonam Makleinam diez ko neveicas. Viņa laulība pamazām izirst, viņš ir atstādināts no amata, un nu Hansa Grūbera (vācu terorists, kuru Džons nosvieda no jumta pirms pāris gadiem) brālis draud uzspridzināt kādu skolu, ja Makleins nepiekritīs skraidīt pa pilsētu, cenšoties atrisināt Grūbera bīstamos uzdevumus.

programme.title: LaLiga. Barcelona - Real Madrid
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Partizan - Crvena Zvezda
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Futbols: Bundesliga. Mainz - Werder Bremen
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Futbols: Ligue 1. PSG - Lyon
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Tropical dreamers will be shown island properties that fit into any budget, from ultra-affordable to totally outrageous. We'll follow everyday families is search of their own slice of paradise, and prove that fantasy can be reality.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programme.desc: Recent lottery winners look for their perfect dream house in this "House Hunters"-inspired reality show. David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find "My Lottery Dream Home".

programme.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Attempting to bring families' dreams come to life, but on a budget, Beachfront Bargain Hunt shows that you don't have to be a millionaire if you want to live a life by the sea! Narrated by John Beach, this show follows a number of couples, families and people looking just for themselves exploring various beachfront's in USA, looking for homes that won't break the bank. Ensuring each person gets what they want, they are introduced to a number of properties that meet their ultimate dream home in the hopes that they will indeed find the one. With 101 episodes, Beachfront Bargain Hunt introduces you to the life that can be led, without breaking to bank, to live a life by the sea!

programme.title: House Hunters

Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"
